<p align="center"><font size="2" face="serif">RULE 13(a)-14(b) CERTIFICATION<br>
PURSUANT TO<br>
18 U.S.C. SECTION 1350,<br>
AS ADOPTED PURSUANT TO<br>
SECTION 906 OF THE SARBANES-OXLEY ACT OF 2002*</font></p>
<p align="left"><font size="2" face="serif">      In connection with the Quarterly
    Report of Brandywine Operating Partnership, L.P. (the &#8220;Partnership&#8221;)
    on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2004 as filed with the Securities
    and Exchange Commission on the date hereof (the &#8220;Report&#8221;), I,
    Gerard H. Sweeney, President and Chief Executive Officer of Brandywine Realty
    Trust, the Partnership&#8217;s
    General Partner, certify, pursuant to 18 U.S.C. Section 1350, as adopted
    pursuant to Section 906 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002, that: </font></p>
<table width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" border="0">
<tr valign="top">
<td width="3%"><font size="2" face="serif">  1.  </font></td>
<td width="1%"><font size="2">&nbsp;</font></td>
<td align="left">
<font size="2" face="serif"> The Report fully complies with the requirements of Section 13(a) or 15(d), as applicable, of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934; and  </font></td>
</tr>
<tr valign="top">
  <td><font size="2">&nbsp;</font></td>
  <td><font size="2">&nbsp;</font></td>
  <td align="left"><font size="2">&nbsp;</font></td>
</tr>
</table>
<table width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" border="0">
<tr valign="top">
<td width="3%"><font size="2" face="serif">  2.  </font></td>
<td width="1%"><font size="2"> &nbsp;</font></td>
<td align="left">
<font size="2" face="serif"> The information contained in the Report fairly presents,
in all material respects, the financial condition and result of operations of
the Partnership.  </font></td>
</tr>
</table>
<p align="left"><font size="2" face="serif"><u>/s/ Gerard H. Sweeney</u><br>
Gerard H. Sweeney<br>

of Brandywine Realty Trust, <br>

Brandywine Operating Partnership, L.P.<br>
